description: Owner-approved, version-pinned license exceptions for the license gate in tools/scripts/New-ThirdPartyNotices.ps1. A package is exempt only when BOTH its id and its exact version match an entry. Any other version of these packages, and any other package outside docs/allowed-licenses.json, still fails the gate. A new version needs a new owner approval (D-00, D-18). An entry that no longer matches a package in the build also fails the gate, so the list cannot go stale.
